notes.title: v0.1.3.0
notes.notes:
This update may not be a lot for players but more of a developer oriented update. Making it easier for future updates

[list]
[*] Changed continuous mode from 10 lives to 15
[*] Reworked Customization UI and countdown slightly. As well to the stats page (minor)
[*] Redid the entire game logic (took a while) and some of the functionality of the AI
[*] Added Level Loader Tool for those which complete the game (if anyone does lol)
[*] Adjusted some sounds like the mortar and mine explosions
[*] Some unnoticeable changes for future updates were also done
[/list]

notes.title: Elite Tanks v0.1.2.0
notes.notes:
After a break, I am back to finally update the game. Did a small update to fix some stuff I wanted to take care of before I left.

[b]Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Shells no longer randomly fly off in weird directions. I had a system in place to destroy the shell in the event of this happening, but it no longer happens
[*] Made small UI adjustments to make it more visible in some of the levels. Might get another redo later down the line
[/list]

I know it's a small list of fixes, but it's a start. Looking to do more soon (and not only fixes but features). 
If any bugs which concern you come up, please report them to the discord: https://discord.gg/39eHX5
